secret-enemies-of-true-republicanism-mos:
Andrew B. Smolnikar published this long treatise at Springhill, Pennsylvania, in 1859. Smolnikar had spent eighteen years as a Benedictine monk and a crown professor of Bible studies before leaving that life in 1838. He held that signs and forecasts had named him a herald of a new age.

Smolnikar argues that hidden foes block true republican rule and stir up wars and revolts. His plan would free nations from kings and harsh rule, then bring lasting peace and fairness to the whole globe. The book blends faith, forecasts, and politics in a call for a world remade.
